THE BLUE DOME AND THE GLOW IN THE WALL: a vast dome of layered blue ice curving up and out of sight overhead, its flat bands of colour stepping upward in hard pixel edges, the older wall of ice standing behind and closing both sides of the frame, and a great glowing mass of pale blue ice buried deep inside the far wall with the wall's own ice reading all around it and its chunky stepped sides burning softly from within

THE BLUE DOME AND THE SLEIGH IN THE FROST: a vast dome of layered blue ice arching overhead in flat stepped bands of pale and deeper blue, the curved wall wrapping both sides and meeting the floor in a worn uneven rim, and a sleigh half-sunk in the frost floor off to one side, its runners still catching the blue light from above

THE BLUE DOME AND THE LITTLE FROZEN TREE: a vast dome of layered blue ice rising in flat pixel bands of blue and white, the ice wall curving down both sides and closing the frame all around, the floor wide and worn and gently uneven, and a little frozen tree standing whole inside the far wall with its branches spread, perfectly still behind clear ice

THE BLUE DOME: a vast dome of layered blue ice vaulting overhead, its bands reading as hard flat steps of blue, the ice wall enclosing both sides and sealing the frame, the floor broad and worn toward the centre, and, a column of bubbles frozen in place rising through the clear ice moon face that glows softly from within the ice low on the far wall

THE FROZEN-WATERFALL HALL AND THE LIT DOOR: a whole end wall that is a frozen waterfall standing in rounded ranks of uneven height like the pipes of a great organ, the chamber's own ice running down both sides of the frame and closing overhead in a low vault, and a small wooden door frozen shut low in the ice with its little round window lit warmly from behind

THE FROZEN-WATERFALL HALL AND THE GREAT KEY: a whole end wall that is a frozen waterfall standing in rounded ranks of very different heights, the chamber's ice enclosing both sides in hard pixel edges and meeting it overhead, the floor stepping unevenly down toward the fall, and a great flat key held in the clear ice of the left wall at shoulder height, its outline crisp behind the blue

THE FROZEN-WATERFALL HALL AND THE CHANDELIER: a whole end wall that is a frozen waterfall standing in tall rounded ranks, the widest rank leaning slightly left of centre, the chamber's own ice running down both sides and vaulting close overhead, and a chandelier of icicles of wildly different lengths hanging over the middle of the floor in hard stepped pixel edges

THE FROZEN-WATERFALL HALL AND THE DARK BELL: a whole end wall that is a frozen waterfall standing in rounded uneven ranks, the ice of the chamber closing both sides and arching overhead, the worn floor angling gently downward toward it, and a dark bell held up in the vault above the fall glowing along one crack in a thin line of pale blue light

THE TERRACE OF CLEAR POOLS AND THE PAIR OF SKATES: a chamber stepping down in three shelves of impossibly clear meltwater each rimmed in scalloped white with chunky stepped pixel sides, the ice wall wrapping both sides of the frame and meeting overhead in a rounded vault, and a pair of skates left on a low stone bench at the edge of the highest shelf

THE TERRACE OF CLEAR POOLS AND THE BUBBLES IN THE WALL: a chamber stepping unevenly down in shelves of impossibly clear meltwater rimmed in scalloped white, the ice wall standing close on both sides and closing overhead, the lowest pool darkening into deep still blue, and a rising line of bubbles caught mid-rise in the clear left wall in a column of chunky stepped pixel circles

THE TERRACE OF CLEAR POOLS: a chamber of shelves stepping down unevenly in pools of impossibly clear meltwater each edged in scalloped white, the ice wall wrapping both sides and curving overhead, the right side stepping down a shelf further than the left, and, a fossil fern held deep in the ice, its fronds still spread serpent that glows softly from within the ice on the far wall above the lowest pool

THE CHASM BRIDGE AND THE FROZEN ROPE: a deep dark chasm splitting the chamber floor with a natural arch of ice striding across it well to the right of centre, layered walls rising close on both sides in flat stepped bands and a low vault closing overhead, and an old climbing rope frozen into the left wall beside the arch, still taut at a slight angle

THE CHASM BRIDGE AND THE THREE FOOTPRINTS: a deep dark chasm splitting the chamber floor with a natural arch of ice striding over it in a single off-centre span, the layered ice walls rising on both sides and a rounded vault closing above, the far wall pale and wide, and three small footprints crossing the untouched frost floor just before the arch, the third set apart and pointing away

THE CHASM BRIDGE: a deep dark chasm splitting the chamber floor with a natural arch of ice crossing it toward the left side of the frame, the layered ice walls standing tall on both sides and a vault of ice closing it overhead, and, a hairline crack refrozen into a white feather through the blue on the far wall high above the chasm

THE SPIRALLING ICE TUNNEL AND THE LANTERN: a wide tunnel of glass-clear ice turning away and down in a long leftward curve, its walls ringed in flat bands of blue and white with hard pixel edges glowing warmer at the far turn, the ice ceiling ringing it close all around, and a lantern left burning on an ice ledge just inside the near right wall, its light pooling in chunky stepped pixel glow

THE SPIRALLING ICE TUNNEL AND THE MITTEN IN THE WALL: a wide tunnel of glass-clear ice curving away and downward, its walls banded in flat stepped rings of blue growing darker toward the far glowing turn, the ice vault ringing the tunnel close overhead, and one small mitten frozen into the right wall at hand height, perfectly preserved behind clear blue-tinted ice

THE SPIRALLING ICE TUNNEL AND THE STAIR GOING DOWN: a wide tunnel of glass-clear ice turning away and down in a slow rightward spiral, its walls ringed in flat stepped bands of blue with chunky pixel edges, the ice vault closing close overhead, and a stair of ice steps beginning just left of centre and descending into deepening blue well before the tunnel's far glowing curve

THE ICICLE CROWD AND THE SLEIGH: a low wide chamber hung everywhere with icicles at very different lengths, one hanging far longer than all the rest and dropping nearly to the frost floor left of centre, the roof of ice dipping in stepped pixel edges to meet the tallest of them, the ice walls closing both sides, and a sleigh half-sunk in the frost floor beneath the longest icicle

THE ICICLE CROWD AND THE LANTERN ON THE LEDGE: a low wide chamber hung with icicles of very different lengths crowding the ice vault, one icicle on the far right dropping almost twice as long as its neighbours, the roof of ice pressing close and the ice walls sealing both sides, and a lantern left burning on a narrow ice ledge in the right wall, its glow warming the nearest icicles to amber

THE ICICLE CROWD: a low wide chamber hung with icicles of wildly uneven lengths, the longest hanging well off-centre toward the left in hard stepped pixel edges, the ice vault dipping to meet the tallest of them and the ice walls closing both sides, and, meltwater beaded along every icicle tip and falling in slow drips on the far wall between two short icicle roots

THE THIN CEILING CHAMBER AND THE FROZEN TREE: a broad chamber roofed by a single thin sheet of ice that the light comes right through so it glows pale and even, flat bands of pale blue and white light pressing down through it from above in hard pixel steps, the ice walls standing close on both sides and joining the glowing ceiling at their top edges, and a little frozen tree standing whole inside the far wall with its small branches spread wide

THE THIN CEILING CHAMBER AND THE DARK BELL: a broad chamber roofed by a thin sheet of ice glowing warmly from above in flat stepped bands of pale blue and white, the ice walls enclosing both sides and sealing the frame at the ceiling's edge, the floor wide and gently uneven, and a dark bell held in the thin vault slightly left of centre glowing along one crack in soft pale blue

THE THIN CEILING CHAMBER AND THE GREAT KEY: a broad chamber roofed by a single thin sheet of ice that the light comes right through so it glows in flat pixel bands of white and pale blue, the ice walls closing both sides and meeting the glowing ceiling cleanly in hard pixel edges, the floor stepping down unevenly toward the far wall, and a great flat key held in the clear ice of the far wall just right of centre

THE CLEAR FLOOR ICE AND THE BUBBLES RISING: a chamber floored in clear blue-black ice with chunky stepped white cracks reaching across it, deep still water far below catching the blue light from the walls, the ice walls standing close on both sides and a low vault of ice sealing it overhead, and a rising line of bubbles caught mid-rise in the left wall in a tall rising line of stepped pixel circles

THE CLEAR FLOOR ICE: a chamber floored in clear blue-black ice with white cracks spreading across it in hard pixel edges, deep water far below fading to black, the ice walls pressing close on both sides and a low vault closing overhead, and, a band of trapped grit reading as a dark stratum through the wall on the far wall just above the frost line
